name: EarthShaker

specialAbility.name: Earthquake
specialAbility.description: EarthShaker slams the ground so hard it creates a massive earthquake that stuns the enemy and shakes the whole arena!

lore: EarthShaker was carved out of a mountain by a giant who needed a ride! This massive brown-and-gold beast weighs more than a house, and every time it lands a jump the ground cracks open. The tribal patterns on its armor are ancient symbols of power. When EarthShaker rolls, the WHOLE WORLD shakes!
